newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-OPENER OF YANKEES/ORIOLES PLAYOFF SERIES RAINED OUT.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-OPENER OF YANKEES/ORIOLES PLAYOFF SERIES RAINED OUT.

text.p: Tuesday's opening game of the American League Championship Series between the Baltimore Orioles and New York Yankees at Yankee Stadium has been postponed due to rain.

The opener of the best-of-seven series to determine the American League representative in the World Series has been rescheduled for Wednesday at 4 p.m. EDT. Game Two is now scheduled for Thursday at 3 p.m.
The rest of the series remains as scheduled, with a shift to Baltimore for Game Three on Friday night and Game Four on Saturday night.
Game Five, if needed, will be played in Baltimore Sunday with the series returning to New York for the last two games, if necessary, next Tuesday and Wednesday.
